proof_audit.v12-c12-design: Verified the finite balanced inclusion probabilities 1/2 and 1/6, covariance -1/12, exact cell contrast expansion and independent-cell covariance sum. Each arm's sample variance is unbiased for its finite potential-outcome variance; the stipulated cell-constant effects make the Neyman expression equal the true contrast variance. No normal pivot is inferred.
proof_audit.v12-c12-inference: Inclusive score-group cumulative masses prove finite superuniformity, including nonuniform atom probabilities. Complement assignments bound two-sided p below by 1/18; sharp-zero imputation is unavailable under a merely average-zero null. Selected directions are replayed for every atom including zero; doubling holds only for this symmetric orbit.
proof_audit.v12-c12-transport: Conceptual I is uniform on the fixed roster and independent of whole Z; individual assignments within each cell remain dependent. Conditional cancellation of participation/treatment factors uses level transport separately from randomization. Balanced two-person cells make each arm weight total exactly 24, so ratio equality is finite, not asymptotic.
proof_audit.v12-c12-case5: Common potential-level shifts preserve effects but move levels. Positive-weight rectangular bounds are attained at corners and their convex interpolations; missing-support bounds have explicit endpoint potential laws. Both are population assumption sets, not sample confidence intervals.
proof_audit.v12-c12-restricted: Separate auditor information excludes the hidden oracle and all revealing full-data outputs. The affine statistic yields a discrete cent lattice, not every real point in its envelope. Solving signed absolute comparisons gives exact roots 0,1,2,4; inclusive endpoints and every p-region count are independently covered.
proof_audit.v12-c12-referee: P0–P4 branches retain different units, testing choices, targets and access sets. Reproducible bytes, timestamps and a count diagnostic do not establish identification or prospective information. The open memo and answered retention preserve these distinctions.
